results.identificationRemarks: A redescription of the gobiid fish Cryptocentrus sericus Herre, with clarification of Cryptocentrus leptocephalus and C. melanopus, Doug Hoese, Koichi Shibukawa and Jiro Sakaue, Aquapress Publisher, 2011 https://www.thefreelibrary.com/A+redescription+of+the+gobiid+fish+Cryptocentrus+sericus+Herre%2C+with...-a0322782002 https://fishesofaustralia.net.au/home/species/5008 https://fishesofaustralia.net.au/home/species/1330 Cryptocentrus melanopus: - large red spots on the head; - a broad red bar from the ventral margin of the eye to the middle of the upper jaw, rarely broken into two parts; - an elongate red stripe on upper pectoral fin base; - the first dark body band below the second dorsal fin sloping anteriorly ending entirely before anal fin, usually followed by 4 thin oblique bands (rarely, from some specimen from Australia 3 bands) Cryptocentrus leptocephalus: - has more numerous and smaller spots on the head; - no broad bar below the eye to the jaws; - small round spots on upper pectoral fin base; - the first band below the second dorsal fin partly overlapping the anterior base of the anal fin, followed by 3 sloping bands
